description: agensio: a static-file and reverse-proxy server on standalone Asio with its own HTTP/1.1, TLS, HTTP/2 and HTTP/3 (QUIC) layers, one event loop per worker and a lock-free per-worker index over one shared file cache that serves pre-compressed twins. The benchmark endpoints are a handler module compiled in for the arena (/baseline11, /baseline2, /json/{count}, /pipeline); /static from the mounted directory. HTTP/1.1 on :8080, h1 over TLS on :8081, h2c on :8082, h2 and h3 on :8443 (QUIC over UDP).
